purpose: Drain reusable implementation out of the legacy research continuation without wholesale merge, while separating canonical source authority from product promotion authority.

current_ab_exception.rule: The already-running post-training A/B evaluation may finish against its exact sealed lineage. This exception authorizes no optimizer step, checkpoint mutation, model promotion, canonical M authority, ProductRevision promotion, or new off-main architecture evolution.

path_family_inventory.exceptions: A workflow may be reclassified A only if it is a generic main-based source/test gate with no branch continuation authority.
A machine contract still consumed by reusable code must be inspected before archive-only classification.

path_family_inventory.rule: Resolve from active import graph; later split into A reusable current, B experiment-only, or D superseded.
Require behavioral-consumption closure and distinguish V1 runtime from V2 compiler evidence.
Separate generic builders/auditors from experiment orchestration and superseded preparation paths by imports and current consumers.
Move only tests that protect A/G recovered source; preserve branch/result-specific tests as C/B provenance.

classification_taxonomy.A_REUSABLE_CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION: Generic implementation required by future research or product development; candidate for reviewed main-based recovery PR.
classification_taxonomy.B_CURRENT_EXPERIMENT_EXECUTION_ONLY: Needed to reproduce/finish the current frozen experiment but not automatically reusable product/research source.
classification_taxonomy.C_HISTORICAL_SCIENTIFIC_PROVENANCE: Preregistration, result, binding or decision evidence retained as immutable provenance, not current state authority.
classification_taxonomy.D_SUPERSEDED_IMPLEMENTATION: Implementation replaced by a later validated version; do not promote merely because it is off-main.
classification_taxonomy.E_BRANCH_OWNED_OPERATIONAL_STATE: CURRENT_STATE/CURRENT_PLAN/ledger or continuation mechanism that Platform must replace as authority.
classification_taxonomy.F_OBSOLETE_BRANCH_WORKFLOW: Workflow whose purpose is long-lived branch execution/binding; archive only unless a generic source gate remains necessary.
classification_taxonomy.G_PRODUCT_RELEVANT_CANDIDATE: Implementation potentially needed by the product graph but requires explicit contract/consumer/qualification review before main recovery.
classification_taxonomy.H_UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCY: Cannot be classified safely until import, call, test and behavioral-consumer closure is inspected.

required_audit_passes.exit: Every off-main changed path receives exactly one A-H disposition with source SHA and rationale.
Every A/G candidate has import/call dependency closure and no hidden dependency on E/F state authority.
Reusable candidates have the minimum generic tests needed to preserve semantics on main; branch-specific result tests remain provenance where appropriate.
Shipping-relevant fields identify DEFINED->PRODUCED->QUALIFIED->SERIALIZED->CONSUMED->BEHAVIORALLY_EFFECTIVE lineage or are explicitly marked research-only.
Main source recovery is proven not to mutate ProductRevision or PRODUCTION model selection without separate explicit qualification/promotion.

initial_recovery_slices.rule: Do not copy the directory wholesale. Resolve current model/scene/structure/presentation modules from actual import graph and current experiment/product architecture; exclude superseded cohort/probe/history utilities unless dependency closure requires them.
Recover only the structuralizer/generation/training/inference primitives required by current architecture and future Platform execution; separate A/B-only court tooling from reusable model source.
Recover V1 runtime only after dependency/test closure. Hold Graphics V2 until its evidence/compiler output has a behaviorally-effective runtime consumer.
Preserve exact current run provenance. Reusable fail-closed decode/parity primitives may later be reclassified A after dependency audit; scientific bindings/results remain C.
